responsibility: Provides the x86 AVX-512PF intrinsic header for gather/scatter prefetch operations. It defines the API for masked and unmasked i32/i64 gather-prefetch and scatter-prefetch intrinsics across packed single- and double-precision index forms, mapping them to GCC builtins and handling optimized vs macro fallback forms; unlike most AVX-512 headers, this one is dedicated to prefetch side-effect instructions rather than arithmetic.
